```{=html}
<script>
// Each card shows the state of its presentation's Julia process, as the playground's server answers it.
(() => {
  const update = async () => {
    try {
      const states = await (await fetch('/api/presentations')).json();
      document.querySelectorAll('a.quarto-grid-link').forEach(link => {
        const name = link.getAttribute('href').match(/presentations\/([^/]+)\//)?.[1];
        const body = link.querySelector('.card-body');
        if (!states[name] || !body) return;
        const mark = body.querySelector('output') ?? body.appendChild(document.createElement('output'));
        mark.dataset.state = states[name].state;
        mark.textContent = 'Julia ' + states[name].state;
      });
    } catch (_) { /* Without the playground's server, the cards do not show a state. */ }
  };
  update();
  setInterval(update, 2000);
})();
</script>
```
